RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 25

Raising the panel's gender composition without concrete evidence of bias will likely damage your professional reputation and burn academic bridges. An all-female panel is not proof of discrimination; committees are frequently formed based on availability, rank, or service rotations. 

Academic appointments depend heavily on strategic fit—such as curriculum needs where industry experience is specifically sought—along with interview performance, teaching evaluations, and department vision, not solely publication tallies. Furthermore, two weeks is a standard administrative delay in university hiring. 

Follow up politely for constructive professional feedback without referencing the panel's demographic makeup. Making an issue of gender here is unsubstantiated and counterproductive to your career.
